bio.text: John Vincent, of Myrtle Beach, launched a campaign as a Democrat for South Carolina's 7th Congressional District in April 2025, the SC Daily Gazette reported.
The Gazette reported that Vincent is a native of Long Island, New York, and retired from the Navy in 2003 as a command master chief petty officer after about 20 years of military service.
He was stationed at the former Charleston Navy base from 1983 to 1992, worked seven years in Florence as a sales manager for WBTW-TV, and co-wrote a book on diversity and inclusion with his wife.

sources.title: Navy veteran hopes to be first Democrat this century to represent Grand Strand, Pee Dee in Congress
